lines.zh: 我走得不急，空气先让开
lines.en: I walk unhurried; the air parts first.
Sparks twine at my shoulder, flashing with each step.

lines.zh: 每一步都压出一道浅痕
lines.en: Each step presses a shallow track.
My gold burns brighter, edged with current.

lines.zh: 残影有时不走，留在原地
lines.en: Sometimes an afterimage stays behind.
I climb the gravel slope.
My ki shoves the dead branches aside.
I watch ahead, not the ground.
Very light steps, landing silent.
I round the cliff; my coat hem flips.

lines.zh: 这形态的步子比刚才快
lines.en: This form's stride is quicker than before.
Step by step, I shorten the distance.
Sparks run a loop down my arm.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，看着指间的电
lines.en: I raise my hand and watch the current.

lines.zh: 气收了三分，四周才安静
lines.en: I lower my ki a third; the air quiets.

lines.zh: 这已经是第二个阶段了
lines.en: This is the second stage already.
I shut my eyes and hear faint sounds in the wind.
The ground under me still trembles.
I hold one breath back.
The power in my bones grinds its teeth.
I have already thought through the outcome.
My shoulders sag, then square again.
The pressure in my chest sits heavy.

lines.zh: 我在等一个值得的理由
lines.en: I wait for a reason worth this.
My hair stands straighter yet.
A spark jumps across my knuckles.
I look up at you with current in my eyes.

lines.zh: 这个形态，不是随便亮的
lines.en: This form is not lit for show.
Standing that far—are you afraid?

lines.zh: 你的气在我的压力下缩了
lines.en: Your ki shrinks under my pressure.
I do not need a second look.
I wait until you are ready.

lines.zh: 我见过太多你这样的眼神
lines.en: I have seen too many looks like yours.
The current circles my fingertip, unreleased.
I do not shout; shouting is for the weak.
You can barely hold your footing.
Nobody here can stop me.

lines.zh: 我的目光落在你的膝上
lines.en: My eyes drop to your knees.

lines.zh: 别把我看成刚才那个我
lines.en: Do not take me for the one you saw before.
If you are wise, leave.
I lift my chin half an inch.
Are you all the enemy there is?
I grit my teeth; the current scatters.
This wound buys you one step.
I wipe the blood from my face.
My ki absorbed most of it.
Half a step back, then I push in.
The ribs, not the arms.

lines.zh: 你把我的气打散了片刻
lines.en: You scattered my ki for a moment.
Pain narrows my focus.
I spit the blood out.
Not enough. Again.

lines.zh: 这种形态下，我懒得解释
lines.en: In this form I cannot be bothered to explain.
Leave it and go; no words.

lines.zh: 能量消耗太大，我确实饿
lines.en: The cost is high; I am hungry, true.
One bite is enough.
I do not eat soft things.
This will not warm me up.
I take it without looking at you.
Do not think I am grateful.
After this, another round of training.
Keep your own portion.
A spark snaps at you.
Better to hit iron than me.
I did not even step back.
Your shoulder meets my elbow.
Do not stand inside my aura.
I raise a hand; ki catches you.
That jostled my focus.
Our feet leave a dent in the ground.
Again, and I take it as a challenge.
I am long past that age.

lines.zh: 王族的血脉只传给强者
lines.en: Royal blood passes only to the strong.
Side by side is fine; leaning on me is not.
I never let anyone wait for me.

lines.zh: 这话说给谁听都不合适
lines.en: Those words suit nobody here.
I put my hand back at my hip.
There are few I protect.
I walk my own road.

lines.zh: 电光下，人脸会显得陌生
lines.en: Faces look strange under this light.
First make yourself stronger.
A hook of ki lifts it.
One look; it is worthless.
I grip it without breaking it.
Dropped here, it blocks my way.
I flick it aside.
Carrying things slows a strike.
This material is still usable.
I toss it to someone behind.
No time for scavenging.
I grind it into the soil.
Final Flash. Do not blink.
Your ki is sealed in my sight.
Second stage should be enough for you.
I charge for three breaths first.
The afterimage moves first; I arrive after.
Big Bang Attack follows.
Your stance is too square.
Do not step where the ground split.

lines.zh: 我不需要提醒你第二遍
lines.en: I will not warn you twice.
This fight deserves my attention.
Ki brightens to a white point in my palm.
I shift my weight back.
That road — you've already walked it out.
Once I start, I do not stop.

lines.zh: 来吧，让我看看你的极限
lines.en: Come; show me your limit.
I flash to your left.
The afterimage is still in place.
I predict your second step.
Your ki is leaking.
At this range I arrive in one breath.
I slip to your back.
The current leaves a taste in the air.
Your guard is dropping.

lines.zh: 我一直在你转身的方向
lines.en: I am always where you turn.
I have seen that move.
The current pulls gravel up.
Hold a little longer and you are done.
Your breathing is loud.
I gather ki behind my waist.
You retreat; I do not chase, I cut you off.
The last circle.
A charged rush breaks the line.
Meteor combination from above.
Fist, knee, elbow, all arriving.
The afterimage pulls your hand away.
This punch carries current.

lines.zh: 你挡了第一下，第二下呢
lines.en: You blocked the first; and the second?
Ki bursts against your armor.
I land and spin.
I held back a fraction there.
Four strikes, my breathing steady.
Toe to the ground, I drive upward.
That put you back three paces.
My hand is still tingling.
The last blow lands on your shield.
When the dust settles, I am still standing.
Just like that; do not stop.
The lightning comes first; then I land.
Fine cracks spread under my feet.
My gold hair stands dead straight.
This sky is too quiet.

lines.zh: 我先试了试这形态的稳定
lines.en: I test how stable this form is.
The air smells scorched.
Wind changes direction as I land.
Sparks coil round my wrist.
I steady and halve my ki.
Another unknown land.
I count the living nearby.
Gravel dust floats around me.
I shake the cape flat.
The light is too bright; I cannot see far.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下自己身上的光
lines.en: I raise a hand against my own glow.
This place is open enough.
One breath, all iron.
The current pushes some flame away.
My landing cracks the ground.
The water turns the current on me.
The blast throws me out of a crater.
The arrow deflects but still grazes.
The spell bypasses my aura to my core.
Hungry, my sparks thin out.

lines.zh: 天上的雷与我的气撞在一起
lines.en: The sky's lightning clashes with my aura.
Not even current travels here.
